fields.System.Title: OUT-4 — Picking
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Direct pickers along an efficient route, verify by scan what they take, and record it — the
highest-volume activity in the warehouse and where accuracy is won or lost.

Scope

In. Task assignment, location sequencing, scan-verified confirmation, short and zero picks,
task reassignment, batch picking, serial capture.

Out. Packing — that is [OUT-5](OUT-5-packing.md).

Design notes

Scan verification is the main accuracy control. Location scan and product scan. A picker
who takes from a nearer location and confirms the one the system asked for corrupts two
locations at once, with no trail. That single behaviour causes more inaccuracy than any
software bug.

The design consequence: make the correct action the fastest action. If overriding needs a
reason code and three taps and the honest path needs one, honesty wins.

Build OUT-404 alongside OUT-403. Short picks are five to ten percent of picks in a real
warehouse. A design that treats them as a later addition will have them bolted on badly under
pressure. The short path must resolve the remainder explicitly — re-allocate elsewhere, or
release and short the line. Never leave it hanging.

Confirm reduces on-hand and reserved together, in one statement. Reducing one without the
other produces negative availability.

Sequence by pick_sequence, not by location code string. Test it against a realistic
layout — this is invisible in unit tests and expensive every day.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Picking from a nearer location and confirming the asked one | [doc 05 WF 6](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| On-hand reduced but reserved not | [doc 09 §2.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Duplicate confirm on a dropped network | [doc 09 §3.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Short pick with no re-allocation | [doc 09 §5.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Two pickers assigned the same task | [doc 09 §4.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Wrong sequence causing double walking | [doc 03 §4](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
| Batch pick sorted into the wrong compartment | [doc 07 §7](../../../docs/07-phased-delivery-plan.md) |
